name: Reducto
description: Reducto is a document processing API for parsing, extracting, splitting, classifying and editing files.
auth_notes: API key from studio.reducto.ai sent in the Authorization header as a Bearer value.
gate_detail: Free account signup in the docs; Standard plan includes $150 in free usage, then pay-as-you-go. Enterprise features such as VPC, BAA and custom SLA need higher tiers. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Endpoints for parse, extract, split, classify and edit across 30+ file types, with Python, Node.js and Go SDKs, a CLI and Studio.
mcp_notes: Vendor-documented hosted MCP server using a Bearer API key, plus a local uvx server with browser login.
blocker_detail: Usage is billed after the free credits, but no approval or sales step is required to start.

evidence.quote: Sign up for a free account without leaving the docs.
replace your-api-key with a key from studio.reducto.ai/api-keys
Standard includes $150 of free usage, then list rates apply.
The hosted server runs at https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp .
